sources.title: HPL documentation
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: HPCG：時間占比與整體加速
related.titleEn: HPCG: phase fractions and whole-program speedup
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付HPL容量帳、有效性檢查與應用代表性說明；兩容量正確、來源與合成輸入分開，速度結論僅來自有效完成的跑次；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver HPL budgets, validity checks, and a statement of application representativeness. Both capacities must match. Separate sourced context from teaching inputs and base speed claims only on valid completed runs. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 以四階段時間條畫出依序執行，標清求解迭代數和驗證條件保持相同；100/80正確，工作與數值驗證相同，不能把階段加速誇成整機加速。
related.differenceEn: Draw four sequential phases with unchanged solver iteration count and numerical validation conditions. Verify 100 and 80 with equal work and numerical validation. Do not inflate a phase improvement into whole-system speedup.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: FP64 n×n主矩陣容量8n² bytes，未含右手邊、pivot、工作區及分散儲存padding；合成n10000對20000，單位GiB以2^30換算；名義式 8*10000**2/2**30 = 0.745058059692 GiB main matrix；變更式 8*20000**2/2**30 = 2.98023223877 GiB main matrix。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
固定各階段工作時，總時間是階段和；只加速SpMV不能消除平滑、歸約與其他成本；合成SpMV40、平滑30、歸約20、其他10毫秒；SpMV由40改20；名義式 40+30+20+10 = 100 ms/iteration；變更式 20+30+20+10 = 80 ms/iteration。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A main FP64 n×n matrix requires 8 n² bytes, excluding the right-hand side, pivots, workspace, and distribution padding. Synthetic n = 10000 versus 20000. Convert bytes to GiB by dividing by 2^30. Nominal 8*10000**2/2**30 = 0.745058059692 GiB main matrix; changed 8*20000**2/2**30 = 2.98023223877 GiB main matrix. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

With fixed work, total time sums phase times. Faster SpMV does not eliminate smoothing, reductions, or other costs. Synthetic SpMV = 40, smoothing = 30, reduction = 20, other = 10 milliseconds; change SpMV to 20. Nominal 40+30+20+10 = 100 ms/iteration; changed 20+30+20+10 = 80 ms/iteration. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MAGMA：批次小矩陣與啟動攤提
related.titleEn: MAGMA: batched small matrices and launch amortization
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付HPL容量帳、有效性檢查與應用代表性說明；兩容量正確、來源與合成輸入分開，速度結論僅來自有效完成的跑次；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver HPL budgets, validity checks, and a statement of application representativeness. Both capacities must match. Separate sourced context from teaching inputs and base speed claims only on valid completed runs. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 列100矩陣的shape、stride與唯一ID，畫100launch和1launch的時間帳；2500/520與完整820帳一致，100矩陣結果無覆寫。
related.differenceEn: List shapes, strides, and unique identities for all 100 matrices. Draw 100 launches versus one launch. Verify 2500 and 520, include the complete 820-microsecond scenario, and check all 100 results for overwrites.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: FP64 n×n主矩陣容量8n² bytes，未含右手邊、pivot、工作區及分散儲存padding；合成n10000對20000，單位GiB以2^30換算；名義式 8*10000**2/2**30 = 0.745058059692 GiB main matrix；變更式 8*20000**2/2**30 = 2.98023223877 GiB main matrix。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
獨立k工作每次launch l與compute c，Tseparate=k(l+c)；理想一批Tbatch=l+kc；合成k100、l20微秒、c5微秒；比較逐次與理想單批，忽略額外打包；名義式 100*(20+5) = 2500 microseconds；變更式 20+100*5 = 520 microseconds。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A main FP64 n×n matrix requires 8 n² bytes, excluding the right-hand side, pivots, workspace, and distribution padding. Synthetic n = 10000 versus 20000. Convert bytes to GiB by dividing by 2^30. Nominal 8*10000**2/2**30 = 0.745058059692 GiB main matrix; changed 8*20000**2/2**30 = 2.98023223877 GiB main matrix. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Separate jobs cost k(l+c); an ideal single batch costs l+kc for launch cost l and work c per job. Synthetic k = 100, l = 20 microseconds, c = 5 microseconds. Compare separate launches with one ideal batch, excluding packing. Nominal 100*(20+5) = 2500 microseconds; changed 20+100*5 = 520 microseconds. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
